verdict: constant, and it cost this repository a day
why: Every one of the 20 trials rendered the b/ directory as ARTIFACT A, because detection-draw captures round 1 of a stubbed loop and loop.js alternates sides by (round + critic index) parity. The batch therefore CANNOT distinguish 'the mapping is always b' from 'the mapping alternates'. That is not a harmless constant: the inverted detection rate published on 2026-08-27 survived a full day precisely because no trial in the batch disagreed with any other about the mapping. A batch drawing some trials from round 1 and some from round 2 would have produced two contradictory rates inside one run and exposed the inversion immediately. Any future batch should cross the mapping; this one cannot, and no claim here may rest on the mapping having varied.

One distinct template hash is the property that lets these trials be pooled into one rate at all — test/detection-rate.test.mjs fails if there is more than one, because trials judged under different prompts are a rate about no instrument. Here the constant is the intended state and a second value would invalidate the measurement rather than strengthen it. Note the redaction keeps the A/B mapping inside this hash, which is why a single value across the batch is also proof the whole batch shared one mapping — the constant above.

why: null on every row because these trials were drawn before the runner recorded the paths it built each prompt from. The consequence is stated in the #29 verdict: re-parsing this ledger on a machine whose tmpdir differs reproduced 0 of 20 stored prompt hashes, so those hashes are carried forward rather than recomputed. Rows drawn after 9aa7ac1 record the paths; nothing here may claim the prompts are reproducible.

verdict: constant by ABSENCE, not by design
why: null on every row for the same reason as a_path, and the pair being constant TOGETHER is the part worth stating: the runner recorded neither path, so a re-parse cannot rebuild either side of the prompt it scored. No claim here may treat these prompts as reproducible; rows drawn after 9aa7ac1 record both paths and are.

verdict: a ledger of one row establishes nothing
why: One refusal has ever been recorded. Every field is constant by sample size rather than by design, so no rate, tendency or pattern may be read from this file — it is a record that one thing happened, and it is cited that way. It becomes analysable at two rows; until then a check reporting twelve constant fields would bury that single fact in noise.
